notes: The .example host is an intentional placeholder reserved for documentation.
Replace landing.url and landing.qrTarget with production URLs, then run node scripts/build-qr.mjs.
Keep the UTM parameters on the QR target so print scans can be attributed separately from direct visits.
spine.qrTarget feeds public/qr/spine-mark.svg (asset C3); rebuild with node scripts/build-qr.mjs.

spine.label: Spine mark
spine.note: Public preview layer entry; resolves before the book is claimed and carries no reader data (worldview D4).

pageEdge.label: Page-edge mark
pageEdge.note: Claim layer at P.042, read by the phone in the claim chapter. Attaches the cloud soul to this copy and writes no reader data (worldview D4). Higher error correction because it is scanned at an angle on a curved edge.
